description: Find manufacturers, wholesalers, and distributors for a product in one of 20 countries. Give product (for example cast iron cookware) and optionally country, role, and max_results. The actor searches Google, checks each company's own website with the Mamba Labs Website Phrase and Business Model Classifier, and returns one row per supplier: company_name, domain, website_url, roles_detected, product_evidence_text and role_evidence_text quoted from the site with their page URLs, and a 0.6 to 0.95 confidence. Directories, marketplaces, and social networks are never returned. When nothing qualifies, one free summary row says why. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per supplier returned plus the classifier's price per site checked.

country.description: Two letter country code to search in. Default US.

extra_keywords.description: Up to 5 extra search words, for example private label.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional cap on the whole run, website checks included.

max_results.description: Most supplier rows to return, 1 to 100. Default 20. About twice this many company sites are checked.

product.description: What the suppliers make or sell, for example cast iron cookware.

require_product_mention.description: true (default): return a company only when its own pages name the product.

role.description: Supplier type to search for and return. Default any.

name: find_suppliers
title: Find manufacturers and suppliers
